name: motion-drag-resistance
title: Drag Resistance
description: Con trỏ kéo mép phải đi trước, mép trái theo sau nên viên thuốc giãn ra; thả tay nó bật về chỗ cũ.

moworks.author: moworks

options.cursor: an optional cursor on the front edge

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Grab the right edge: it moves +92 px in 600 ms power2.inOut while the left edge lags (follows 100 ms later, width kept within 80–108 px: scaleX up to 1.35, height 1/scaleX); release: the pill springs back (k 220, d 16) ~12 px past its slot and settles, stretching up to +18 % with speed on the way. Params: pull (92 px) · lag: trễ mép sau (0.1 s) · stretch max (1.35) · spring (k 220, d 16).
moworks.titleVi: Kéo nặng tay, mép sau trễ lại
